schema.text: Thinking about your typical trip (the trip you make most often in a typical week), how safe do you consider the travel environment to be in relation to accidents and road conditions?

en.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Thinking about your typical trip (the trip you make most often in a typical week), how safe do you consider the travel environment to be in relation to accidents and road conditions?

it.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Pensando al tuo spostamento abituale (lo spostamento che fai più spesso in una settimana tipica), quanto ritieni sicuro l'ambiente di spostamento rispetto a incidenti e condizioni stradali?

fr.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: En pensant à votre trajet habituel (celui que vous faites le plus souvent au cours d’une semaine type), dans quelle mesure jugez-vous l’environnement de déplacement sûr en ce qui concerne les accidents et l’état des routes ?

de.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Wenn Sie an Ihren typischen Weg denken (den Weg, den Sie in einer typischen Woche am häufigsten zurücklegen): Wie sicher empfinden Sie die Verkehrsumgebung im Hinblick auf Unfälle und Straßenverhältnisse?

tr.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Tipik yolculuğunuzu (tipik bir haftada en sık yaptığınız yolculuk) düşündüğünüzde, kazalar ve yol koşulları açısından ulaşım ortamını ne kadar güvenli buluyorsunuz?

fa.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: با در نظر گرفتن سفر معمول خود (سفری که در یک هفته معمولی بیشتر از همه انجام می‌دهید)، محیط رفت‌وآمد را از نظر تصادف و وضعیت راه‌ها چقدر ایمن می‌دانید؟

hu.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Szokásos útjára gondolva (amelyet egy átlagos héten a leggyakrabban tesz meg), mennyire tartja biztonságosnak a közlekedési környezetet a balesetek és az útviszonyok szempontjából?

ar.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: بالتفكير في رحلتك المعتادة (الرحلة الأكثر تكرارًا في أسبوع عادي)، ما مدى أمان بيئة التنقل من حيث حوادث الطرق وحالة الطرق برأيك؟
